title: mergus_cli
description: The description of the Mergus command line that `mergus schema` prints: every command with its arguments, their types and allowed values, and its exit codes (MG-REQ-0263, MG-REQ-1348).

contract_version.description: The major version of the contract.

mergus_version.description: The version of the Mergus binary that printed the document.

commands.description: The commands described, sorted by name.

command.description: One command of the command line.

name.description: The name of the command as typed, its words separated by one space, such as `new model`.

summary.description: What the command does, in one sentence.

exit_codes.description: The exit codes the command may end with (`contracts/events.md` section 2).

json.description: Whether `--json` makes the command print the events of `mergus_events` on standard output.

name.description: The name of the argument: an option or a flag as typed, such as `--gold`; a positional argument without dashes.

type.description: The type of the value of the argument; `boolean` for a flag.

required.description: Whether the argument must be given.

repeatable.description: Whether the argument may be given more than once.

default.description: The value used when the argument is not given, as a string.

values.description: The values the argument allows, when it allows only some.
